gloss: to hold, to have, to carry

definitions.explanation: To have something in one's hands or to carry something. Physical possession or holding.
To own or possess something. {車|くるま}を{持|も}っている (to have a car).
For something to remain in good condition or to endure. この{電池|でんち}は{長|なが}く{持|も}つ (this battery lasts long).

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}ちましょうか。
{右手|みぎて}で{箸|はし}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: I hold chopsticks with my right hand.

examples.japanese: {重|おも}い{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}って{歩|ある}くのは{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: It's hard to walk while carrying heavy luggage.

examples.japanese: {両手|りょうて}でしっかり{持|も}ってください。{落|お}とすと{危|あぶ}ないですから。
examples.english: Please hold it firmly with both hands. It's dangerous if you drop it.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}を{持|も}っていません。
この{店|みせ}は{長|なが}い{歴史|れきし}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: This shop has a long history.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{才能|さいのう}を{持|も}っている。
{日本|にほん}には{古|ふる}い{歴史|れきし}を{持|も}つ{建物|たてもの}がたくさんあって、{見|み}るだけでも{楽|たの}しい。
examples.english: There are many buildings with old history in Japan, and it's fun just to look at them.

examples.japanese: この{電池|でんち}は{長|なが}く{持|も}つ。
この{食|た}べ{物|もの}は{持|も}たない。
{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}は{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}に{入|い}れれば{長|なが}く{持|も}つ。
examples.english: Milk will keep longer if you put it in the refrigerator.

examples.japanese: {体力|たいりょく}が{持|も}たない。
このパンは{賞味期限|しょうみきげん}が{短|みじか}いので、{三日|みっか}ぐらいしか{持|も}たない。
examples.english: This bread has a short expiration date, so it only lasts about three days.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{持|も}つ (hold/have X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {持|も}っている = 'has/possesses' (ownership state, very common).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{傘|かさ}を{持|も}っている (have an umbrella)
・{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}つ (carry luggage)
・{車|くるま}を{持|も}っている (own a car)
・{長|なが}く{持|も}つ (last long)

Godan verb: te-form {持|も}って. Compare: ある (existence), {持|も}つ (ownership/carrying). Sense 3 (last/endure) is intransitive usage.
